ruleset: OWASP CRS 4.25.1 LTS (crs-manifest.json bundled in release; rule_files=27, unique_rule_ids=628)
traffic_control: disabled for this run (default 60 req/min per-IP rate limit would have confounded detection measurement)
upstream: python3 -m http.server 127.0.0.1:9999 (dummy origin; allowed requests proxied, blocked requests answered at edge)
adapter: benchmarks/real_comparative/adapters/aegis_replay.py (Phase-3: full HTTP round-trip incl. upstream; latency not comparable to satbench in-memory)
blocked_rule: HTTP response carried X-Aegis-Waf: blocked (403) or transport error; upstream-originated statuses (incl. 501 from the dummy origin) count as allowed
notes: latency_us is full HTTP round-trip through the Aegis proxy including upstream hop; NOT comparable to satguardian in-memory figures
heldout_v10.jsonl is a batch authored inside the satguardian repository; CRS/aegis never saw it during tuning
crs_v430.jsonl is the vendor-authored OWASP CRS v4.30 test suite; aegis runs CRS 4.25.1, not 4.30
no TLS, no geoip db, no rate limiting, community edition; results describe this configuration only
benign_pooled: benign_heldout_v3_v10.jsonl: all label=benign cases from heldout_v3..v10 (665 cases); aegis blocked 152 (22.9% FPR, 95% CI 19.8-26.2%)
